name: Events Manager – Venues, Organizers and Events Management By WebCodexWorld
author: WebCodexWorld

sections.description:
WebCodexWorld Events Manager is a minimalistic, lightweight, and modern event calendar plugin for WordPress that helps you create, organize, and display professional events. Whether you’re managing conferences, workshops, seminars, meetups, business events, exhibitions, training programs, or community gatherings, this event calendar plugin gives you the essential tools in one place, without the clutter or bloat of an all-in-one events suite.

Create unlimited events, venues, and organizers with dedicated management screens. Display an event calendar archive and single event pages using responsive layouts that work on all devices. Enhance your WordPress event calendar with Google Maps, QR code generation, featured events, categories and tags, timezone support, all-day event scheduling, and customizable date and time formats. The plugin also includes flexible shortcodes, related events, archive customization, default featured images, a visual Layout Builder, and developer-friendly hooks.

Why WebCodexWorld Events Manager?

  • Minimalistic — A clean, uncluttered admin screen with vertical tabs and clear labels, so you can configure and manage your event calendar without wading through unnecessary options.
  • Lightweight — No page-builder dependency and no unnecessary front-end weight: a single small stylesheet and script are loaded on the front end, and admin assets only load on the screens that need them. A genuinely simple event calendar plugin, not a bloated events suite.
  • Modern — Built on current WordPress APIs, with Block Editor (Gutenberg) support for Events, Venues, and Organizers, and native Full Site Editing (FSE) block templates for block themes.

Features

  • Unlimited events with a dedicated Event list page.
  • Dedicated Venue management with address, contact details, map etc.
  • Dedicated Organizer management with phone number, email, website etc.
  • Event Categories and Event Tags with their own archive pages.
  • Beautiful, responsive Single Event and event archive/calendar pages.
  • Custom URL slugs for events, categories, and tags.
  • Visual Layout Builder for building reusable, shortcode-driven layouts.
  • [em_wcw_event_list], and [em_wcw_related_events] shortcodes.
  • Event date, time, and timezone management, including all-day events.
  • Google Maps integration for venues and events.
  • Add to Google Calendar / Outlook, and downloadable .ics files.
  • QR code generation for events.
  • “Hide From Listing” option.
  • Currency, date, and time formatting settings.
  • Default featured images for events, venues, and organizers.
  • Block Editor (Gutenberg) support, with Full Site Editing template support.
  • Translation ready.
  • Developer-friendly hooks and filters.

Included Shortcodes

[em_wcw_event_list] — Display a filterable, searchable, paginated list of events for your event calendar.

[em_wcw_related_events] — Display events related to the one currently being viewed.

[em_wcw_tmpl id="123"] — Render a layout created with the Layout Builder.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services to provide certain optional features. These features are opt-in. The plugin does not contact them unless you enable the corresponding setting or an event/venue uses the corresponding field.

  1. Google Maps
  2. Google Calendar
  3. Microsoft Outlook (Office 365 / Outlook.com)
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Events Manager – Venues, Organizers and Events Management By WebCodexWorld” OR “WebCodexWorld Events Manager”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the zip, or extract it into /wp-content/plugins/webcodexworld-events-manager/ via FTP/SFTP.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.

After activation

  1. Go to Events Manager > Settings and review the General, Event Single, Events List/Archive, Currency, Date & Time, and Maps tabs (the Welcome tab summarizes all of this).
  2. Create one or more Venues.
  3. Create one or more Organizers.
  4. Create your first Event and attach the venue/organizer.
  5. An “Events” archive page is created automatically on activation with the [em_wcw_tmpl id="event_archive"] shortcode. Add [em_wcw_event_list] or [em_wcw_related_events] to any other page or post as needed.
  6. Optionally, build a custom layout in Events Manager > Layout Builder and assign it in Settings.
sections.faq:
Is this a good event calendar plugin for WordPress beginners?

Yes. WebCodexWorld Events Manager is built to be a simple, minimalistic event calendar plugin — install it, create a venue and an organizer, then create your first event. There’s no page-builder dependency and no bloated settings screen to wade through.

How do I create a WordPress event calendar with venues and organizers?

Go to Events Manager > Venues to add your venue details, then Events Manager > Organizers for your organizer information. When you create a new event, simply attach the venue and organizer you’ve already set up. Full address, contact, and map details carry through automatically.

Does the plugin support unlimited events, venues, and organizers?

Yes, there is no built-in limit on the number of events, venues, or organizers you can create.

Is Google Maps supported, and do I need an API key?

Yes, Google Maps is supported and no API key is needed. Google Maps can be enabled in Events Manager > Settings > Maps. The map is rendered as an embedded map using the venue address.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The front-end output is responsive and mobile friendly.

Can I change the event, category, and tag URL slugs?

Yes, from Events Manager > Settings > Events List / Archive.

Can attendees add an event to their calendar?

Yes. Single events include “Add to Calendar” links for Google Calendar, Outlook, and a downloadable .ics file.

Can I generate QR codes for an event?

Yes, from the QR Code tab on the event edit screen.

Can I customize the archive, category, and tag layouts?

Yes, using the built-in Layout Builder and the layout selectors in Settings.

Does this plugin work with the Block Editor and Full Site Editing themes?

Yes. Block Editor support for Events, Venues, and Organizers can be toggled in Settings > General, and block (FSE) themes get dedicated single-event and taxonomy-archive block templates automatically.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. A .pot file is included in the languages folder.
